name: Atoms
description: Atoms is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Atoms is a privately held industrial automation company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. The company did not disclose a valuation for its most recent financing, a $1.7 billion equity investment announced on July 22, 2026; the last reported valuation, $15 billion, dates from a round in November 2021.

Based in Los Angeles and led by Travis Kalanick, Atoms is the holding company for CloudKitchens, the Otter restaurant software business and the Lab37 food robotics unit, together with Pronto, which develops self-driving systems for mining vehicles. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Atoms
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round by The Wall Street Journal (2019) and Business Insider (2021); Atoms did not disclose a valuation for its July 2026 investment. The earlier rounds were raised by CloudKitchens' parent company before its businesses were combined into Atoms.
round_notes: Ben Horowitz of Andreessen Horowitz joined the board with the July 2026 investment. Atoms also named Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, JPMorgan and Barclays as debt partners but did not disclose the size or terms of those facilities.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Andreessen Horowitz led the July 2026 equity investment, with participation from Bain Capital Ventures, Uber, Fifth Wall, Chemistry, K5 Global and SV Angel. Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund made the 2019 investment, according to The Wall Street Journal.
spv_sentence: In 2026, 14 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Atoms filed with the SEC.
sources: Sources: Atoms' announcement of its equity investment; a TechCrunch report (July 2026); reports by Business Insider (November 2021) and The Wall Street Journal (November 2019); and SEC Form D filings.
